sources.eto: Mean monthly reference evapotranspiration (product name/version: to be completed)
sources.sw: Monthly surface-water availability (product name/version: to be completed)
sources.gw: Monthly groundwater availability; the 12 monthly values are summed to an annual storage (product name/version: to be completed)
sources.season: Rainfall-peak analysis (peak 1 start / end month, smoothed)

assumptions.groundwater_method_text: Annual groundwater storage = sum of the 12 monthly groundwater values x usable fraction (fixed at the start of the season). Each growing month, irrigation need that surface water cannot meet is taken from the storage that is left; the storage is reduced by what is used. A month has no gap while the remaining storage covers its need. Once the storage is used up, the rest is gap.

uncertainty: Spatial P10 / P90 ranges are not included in this release.
limitations: Monthly climatological planning model (12 mean months). It is not a forecast and not a real-time monitor.
Values are ADM2 averages (mm, over mapped crop cells) or ADM2 totals (MCM). Not suitable for field scale.
All crops share one land mask: crop area is mapped eligible agricultural area, not crop-specific area.
Crop coefficients and stage lengths are FAO-56 planning defaults; okra values are provisional and need local validation.
Effective rainfall = 80% of rainfall (capped at the crop water requirement); 100% of surface water is usable each month; gross irrigation need uses an efficiency factor of 1.54.

Groundwater is one annual storage (sum of the 12 monthly values x 50% usable) that is used up month by month during the season. Each crop-season scenario starts with the full annual storage: it does not account for other crops, the other season, other water users or recharge during the season.
Season start comes from rainfall-peak analysis. The Dry-season raster is a peak-1 END-month raster; check the start offset setting.
Missing surface-water, groundwater or rainfall cells inside the crop mask are treated as zero supply.
Spatial uncertainty ranges (P10 / P90) are not included in this release.
method_version: v7-server (groundwater = annual storage used up month by month; other equations of v5.1)
